blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Marcos on Tuesday announced that the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) and the United States have adopted the 10 Public-Private Partnership Principles for Tackling Online Scams and the Comprehensive Work Plan to guide their strategic partnership. He made the announcement during the Asean-US Special Summit with US President Donald Trump,
